title: Board panel polish: coalesced-click feedback, visibilitychange refresh, a11y live region, test gaps
outcome: Deferred P3 follow-ups from the 2026-07-27 dual review of the board visibility slice (blockers were fixed in-slice): (1) acknowledge coalesced manual Refresh clicks — drive the button's pending state off the in-flight claim so a click during a background probe is not a silent no-op; (2) refresh once on visibilitychange back-to-visible instead of waiting up to a full interval; (3) a11y — polite live region announcing updated entries; the 'updated' badge currently has no AT signal; (4) test gaps — .board-panel-last-write chip, '1 write' pluralisation branch, background-probe-failure-surfaces-error / background-success-clears-standing-error pair, manual-click-coalesces-behind-background-probe path; (5) consider reusing the chained-poll helper (active-prompt-poll.ts) instead of setInterval+guard, or document the deliberate divergence in the module header.
